benchmark.interpretation: Functional smoke only; two samples per mode, no statistical or real-web claim.

limitations: Native host-permission dialog requires a human click; test harness pregrants its copied manifest.
Domains and TLS keys are synthetic public test data. No real government or bank sites tested.
Sensitivity classification is incomplete and the optional automatic Chrome permission is technically broad.
No absolute transferred-byte ceiling or zero-vulnerability claim.
Stable Chrome and oldest supported version not manually verified.
